codeSnippets.description: Generic Repository implementation with dynamic reflection-based column selection in GORM

patterns.codeStructure: pkg/db/generic_repository.go defines GenericRepository[T schema.Tabler], AST expression helpers (Search, Equal, InArray, ExpressionDateRange), and reflection struct extractors.
considerations: Requires struct tags with `gorm:"column:..."` for dynamic column projections
All repository methods receive context.Context for cancellation propagation
keyImplementationPoints: Go generics constraint on schema.Tabler interface
Parameterized AST clause expressions to prevent SQL injection
patterns.overview: Generic repository pattern for GORM leveraging Go 1.18+ type parameters to provide type-safe CRUD, dynamic expression building, and reflection-based selective field loading.
patterns.purpose: Eliminate boilerplate CRUD queries while keeping strict type safety and SQL injection protection.
patterns.summary: Type-safe generic repository abstraction with dynamic GORM expression builders and reflection-driven column projections.
patterns.title: Go GORM Generic Repository & Dynamic Expression Builder Pattern

codeSnippets.description: Multi-repository unit-of-work transaction coordinator in Go GORM

patterns.codeStructure: pkg/db/dbTransaction.go provides DBTransaction struct and BaseRepository interface.
considerations: Repositories must implement BaseRepository.SetupConnection to swap the GORM instance
Ensure defer trx.End(err) is used to avoid hanging database transactions
keyImplementationPoints: Decoupled transaction management from business usecase layer
Transparent DB session switching across multiple repositories
Automatic atomic rollback or commit via End(err)
patterns.overview: Declarative unit-of-work transaction manager that coordinates multiple repositories within an atomic GORM transaction.
patterns.purpose: Provide atomic ACID multi-repository transactions without exposing raw database connection objects to service logic.
patterns.summary: Declarative Multi-Repository Unit-of-Work Transaction Coordinator managing GORM transactions across distinct repositories.
patterns.title: Declarative Multi-Repository Unit-of-Work Transaction Coordinator

codeSnippets.description: Domain error hierarchy with Gin HTTP translation and localization mapping

patterns.codeStructure: pkg/localerror/util.go defines domain errors and pkg/mapper/errors.go maps errors to localized JSON responses.
considerations: Domain errors should never expose database driver errors directly to clients
Internal server errors must be logged and replaced with a generic localized message
keyImplementationPoints: I18n localized message lookup using user context language
Decoupled HTTP status and payload formatting via Mapper
patterns.overview: Hierarchical domain error architecture separating business errors from transport layer responses with multi-language i18n support.
patterns.purpose: Provide clean error boundaries and uniform localized error responses for frontend consumers.
patterns.summary: Structured Domain Error Hierarchy & I18n Response Mapping Pattern separating domain errors from HTTP transport with localization.
patterns.title: Structured Domain Error Hierarchy & I18n Response Mapping Pattern

codeSnippets.description: Modular JWT auth middleware with RBAC and Redis session tracking

patterns.codeStructure: iam_module/pkg/middleware/session.go and iam_module/pkg/security/authenticate.go provide authentication and authorization.
considerations: HMAC signing method verification prevents algorithm confusion attacks
User activity updates should be handled efficiently to avoid slowing down requests
keyImplementationPoints: Stateless JWT token validation with algorithm checks
Stateful Redis session validation for revocable tokens
patterns.overview: Pluggable IAM authentication and authorization middleware combining stateless JWT, stateful Redis session validation, and RBAC.
patterns.purpose: Deliver modular, secure authentication and authorization with seamless role checks and activity tracking.
patterns.summary: Modular JWT Auth Middleware with Redis Stateful Session & Activity Tracking in Go Clean Architecture.
patterns.title: Modular JWT Auth Middleware with Redis Stateful Session & Activity Tracking
